title: NISAR Radar Geometry Blocker Resolution Audit
conditions: Confirm the exact local DEM release is COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED/2023_1 (or quantify height difference vs processor DEM)
Measure radar-grid-to-DEM interpolation error with an explicit error budget before producing 30 m geometry
Identify a non-candidate real terrain validation target from independent evidence
Preserve the unresolved orbit/pointing label values; do not infer geolocation error from labels

blockers_resolved.dem_identity: PARTIAL - same family, release 2023_1 not proven locally
blockers_resolved.resolution_500m: REASSESSED - 30 m defensible with error budget; 10 m not justified

authentication.mission012_netrc_condition: Earthaccess on Windows defaults to _netrc; existing credential file is .netrc
authentication.resolution: Set NETRC environment variable to the existing .netrc path before earthaccess.login(strategy='netrc')
authentication.mission013_method_that_failed: raw requests.get() Range headers without Earthdata session
authentication.mission013_failure_type: text/html Basic-auth challenge; CloudFront 502 on second granule
authentication.probe_redirect: 303 to CloudFront host (header-redirection session handles auth)

egm2008.pgm_format: P5 16-bit big-endian; height = Offset + Scale * pixel
egm2008.sign_convention: h = H + N (ellipsoidal = orthometric + geoid undulation)
egm2008.interpolation_method: bilinear (12-point cubic available via GeographicLib Geoid class)
egm2008.bounded_subset_note: PGM supports random pixel access; a 12-point cubic stencil needs only local pixels. Full global model coefficient set was NOT downloaded.

dem_identity.processor_dem_identity: NISAR DEM version 1.2, Copernicus DEM 30 m release 2023_1, COP-DEM_GLO-30-DGED/2023_1, WGS84 ellipsoid
dem_identity.local_release_field: local XML records 'Copernicus GLO-30 DGED' and 'WorldDEM DSM' but no explicit 2023_1 token
dem_identity.conclusion: Same product family; exact release identity (2023_1) not proven from local metadata. Family match is not proof of identical release.
dem_identity.vertical_datum_difference: local EGM2008 orthometric vs processor WGS84 ellipsoid; conversion now enabled by verified EGM2008 source

approach_A.name: Product metadata interpolation
approach_A.method: tri-linear interpolation of radar-grid geometry cubes to DEM grid with explicit error budget
approach_A.interpolation_error_source: 500 m grid sampled; local terrain curvature at 30 m not represented
approach_A.error_budget: geoid 0.135 m + DEM <4 m LE90 + radar-grid interpolation (must be measured) + MOE orbit geolocation (unmeasured)
approach_A.defensible_at_30m: possible with measured interpolation error; NOT automatically defensible

approach_B.name: Geometry reconstruction from orbit and attitude
inputs: orbit position/velocity [45,3] (10 s sampling per ASF)
approach_B.method: reconstruct platform position and LOS at DEM sample locations; compute local incidence from DEM surface normal
approach_B.sampling: orbit 45 states (~10 s), attitude 126 records, radar-grid height 21 levels
approach_B.advantage: independently reconstructs LOS geometry; not tied to coarse incidence cube
approach_B.limitation: depends on MOE/attitude accuracy and orbit interpolation (Hermite); geolocation error unmeasured
approach_B.defensible_at_30m: plausible and independently checkable; requires validation against known terrain

resolution.conclusion: A 30 m DEM-grid geometry product can be defensible with an explicit error budget and independent validation. 10 m geometry is NOT justified by 10 m GCOV posting. No production raster generated.

orbit.asf_authoritative: NISAR mission uses Medium precision (MOE) data when generating new products (ASF Orbit Ephemeris guide)
orbit.interpretation: MOE is the operational standard; MOE in HDF5 is expected. Filename N likely reflects delivery/fidelity labeling.

pointing.interpretation: Custom attitude indicates adaptive/non-nominal pointing; quaternions are recorded and usable.

discrepancies.remaining_uncertainty: Label semantics and actual geolocation error remain unresolved; derive geometry from recorded state vectors, not labels.

principles: Mission 006 candidate rasters are NOT used to fit or validate the geometry model
Synthetic tests are deterministic and independent of real candidate patches
At least one non-candidate real terrain target must be identified for eventual validation

synthetic_tests.expect: no shadow, no layover; local incidence = ellipsoid incidence
increased local incidence; layover when slope > incidence
points behind ridge along look ray are shadowed
feature top maps to closer slant range than base

validation.non_candidate_target: A catalogued ridge/valley feature from independent optical imagery or published topography, outside all Mission 006 candidate patches (to be identified in the implementation mission)

limitations: No shadow or layover raster generated.
No water reclassification or threshold change.
No complete NISAR HDF5 product downloaded.
DEM release 2023_1 identity not proven from local metadata.
Geolocation error from orbit/attitude labels not measured.
Radar-grid interpolation error at 30 m must be measured in the implementation mission.
